brief: A polished MIDI playback app with a stronger identity, a broader music catalog, and a responsive interface.
criteria: A clear MIDI identity that remains recognizable at app-icon size and works on dark and light surfaces.
label: Piano roll

concepts.name: Piano roll
concepts.idea: Three MIDI event bars turn the rhythm of a piano roll into a compact app mark, with terracotta highlighting the active note.
rationale: The staggered bars connect directly to MIDI notes and timing.
A single warm accent gives the mark a clear focal point in both themes.
The symbol holds its shape as an app icon, while the outlined wordmark works without installed fonts.

recommendation: Use the dark app icon as the default Windows application tile. Keep the light mark for white surfaces and use the standalone symbol at small sizes.
